item.text: The view currently creates one tile per result, and the tile reads a single match index from that result. I’ll accumulate overlapping timelines in the view, then give the tile every match index so contextual events stay distinct from query matches.

The view now defers rendering while adjacent results share a boundary event ID, then renders the accumulated timeline once. Each matched event gets a link built from its own event ID. I’ve updated the tile’s existing test for the new props and am checking types and test results now.

item.text:
Updated room search to combine adjacent results when their timelines share a boundary event. The combined tile renders the shared event once, tracks every direct match for highlighting, and links each match to its own event ID. Results without an overlap still render separately.

The existing SearchResultTile test, TypeScript check, ESLint, and `git diff --check` passed.
